lines: I once hid my faint feelings.
I lock away my true heart.
I dash toward a place no one knows.
I’ll sing the first and last experiment.
It’s firmly etched in my heart.
Only a fragment of this loneliness.
How will tomorrow be?
Even if you ask that, I can’t answer anything.
Even today we’re a little...
We force ourselves to smile and show it.
Still waiting for the meaning of living.
Just explore!
Today I’ll search again, like science.
Completely, utterly chaotic.
Every day, like a flask’s reaction.
I want to find proof of existence.
Alas
Don’t tell me there’s no solution.
This world is desperately alive.
Now discover a theorem no one knows yet.
Bid farewell to this loneliness.
In a few sleepless nights.
If this magic faintly lights up.
Then now isn’t that bad.
Until we can laugh, today is also science!
Even when bitter feelings rise up.
Today I truly locked my heart.
Words can’t convey many things.
And the world was full of absurdity.
Tomorrow’s weather
So I might even be able to foresee this heart’s pattern.
If I understood, how much
I could be at ease, I wonder, today I explore!
I’ll keep searching, like science.
It hurts sharply, precisely.
Someday this pain will become nourishment.
I want to prove the future.
Alas
The solution may not be single.
If we keep struggling, is that the right answer?
Now find an answer no one knows yet.
I want to embrace this loneliness.
A little warmth in the night
Dances, hoping it reaches the farthest sky.
Yesterday’s impatience too
Now lies beyond the waves.
Today I’ll search, like science.
Completely, utterly chaotic.
Every day, like a flask’s reaction.
I want to find proof of existence.
Alas
Don’t say there’s no solution.
This world is desperately alive.
Now discover a theorem no one knows yet.
Bid farewell to this loneliness.
In a few sleepless nights.
If this magic faintly lights up.
Then now isn’t that bad.
Until we can laugh, today is also science!
